issues.detail: The Hebrew 'יִדֹּדוּן יִדֹּדוּן' means 'they flee, they flee' (from the root נדד, 'to flee'), but the Chinese renders it as '必得賞賜' ('will surely receive reward'), which is a mistranslation. The subject 'מַלְכֵי צְבָאוֹת' ('kings of armies') are fleeing, not receiving reward. This changes the meaning of the verse.
